source_snapshot.criteria: Train at expected width and Gen3 speed with no errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.

old_problem: The project has not supplied the proprietary Speed Change 13 primitive, end-to-end Gen3 capability inventory, full-width target, intermediate training/settle rules or accepted error deltas, so the old review treated these project bindings as unresolved engineering decisions.
disposition_reason: The review-layer oracle is sufficiently defined by the Master: five hundred Gen1-to-Gen3 transitions, expected width/speed and no errors. Capability, tool/configuration, path, deadlines and error policy can be bound as Project Configuration. This resolves Pending without claiming the path supports Gen3; if capability evidence is absent or any component cannot meet the signed target, execution is BLOCKED rather than downscoped to Gen2.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2102, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2103 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00025-V002 / fd1234aea1b2c399 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 13 independently covers Gen1-to-Gen3; neither row-2101 Gen2 nor row-2103 Gen4 evidence can replace its exact identity and 500 outcomes.
Before execution, capability evidence must cover root port, switches/retimers, backplane/cabling, endpoint/GPU and firmware at required Gen3 width.
The owner-supplied LTSSM/NVQual configuration defines Gen1 entry, Gen3 request and permitted intermediate Gen2/Recovery/LTSSM trajectory; no generic sequence is invented.
Each numbered transaction records initial Gen1, request, intermediate trajectory, settled Gen3/full-width state, endpoint enumeration, timestamps and fresh error deltas.
A clean final snapshot cannot prove intermediate transitions; all 500 complete records are mandatory and no failed/missing transaction may be replaced.
Interlock before the next action on capability mismatch, unexpected trajectory, late/non-Gen3 settle, downtrain, new disqualifying AER, endpoint loss/reset, evidence gap or health excursion.
No LTSSM/NVQual, Gen1/Gen3 speed action, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Capability-gated Speed Change 13: 500 Gen1-to-Gen3 PCIe transactions
test_case.purpose: Qualify the mapped GB-NV-PVP end-to-end Gen3 path through five hundred individually accepted Gen1-to-Gen3 transitions at required width with an allowed training trajectory and no disqualifying error or health regression.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 13 tool, command and configuration
End-to-end Gen3 capability records for root port, switch/retimer, physical channel, endpoint/GPU and firmware
Immutable path/lane map, required Gen3 width, Gen1 entry and Gen3 request definitions
Permitted intermediate LTSSM/generation trajectory, settle timeout and AER/error policy
Dedicated SUT/window, durable 500-entry ledger, first-fault interlock, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: Execution is BLOCKED until every project binding is approved. Verify end-to-end Gen3 capability and preserve topology/link/error/health baselines; after point authorization execute only the exact Speed Change 13 recipe for ledger entries 1..500. For each entry capture Gen1 start, Gen3 request, complete intermediate LTSSM/generation path, settled speed/width, enumeration, error delta and platform health before the next release. Stop and preserve on the first mismatch or missing artifact; never fall back to Gen2, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped path is demonstrably Gen3-capable and every one of 500 unique transactions follows an allowed training trajectory, settles to Gen3 at the required width within deadline, keeps the endpoint/siblings healthy and adds no disqualifying PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error; final state satisfies the signed oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without capability and complete configuration evidence. Once bound, PASS requires 500 accepted trajectory-complete transactions at Gen3/full width and clean correlated health. FAIL on unsupported component, fallback/downtrain, forbidden intermediate state, timeout, endpoint loss, error/reset or recovery failure. Missing package/config/artifact is BLOCKED; substituting Gen2 or rerunning a failure is prohibited.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the full path proves Gen3 support and the Speed Change 13 trajectory, limits, interlock and recovery are signed.
Dedicated SUT, stable power/cooling, console access and immediate human point approval are required.
Preserve all counters and per-transaction trajectories; the next request depends on durable acceptance of the current one.
Stop without retry at the first capability, transition, width, endpoint, error, evidence or safety failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and Speed Change 13 build/configuration/approval
End-to-end Gen3 capability dossier and immutable path/lane/required-width map
Signed Gen1 entry, Gen3 request, allowed intermediate trajectory, timeout and error contract
Ledger 1..500 with raw initial/intermediate/settled states, width, timestamps, enumeration and tool result
Transaction-correlated link/AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence plus completeness/gap report
First-fault/recovery or clean final Gen3 topology/health, no-downscope/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first capability contradiction, forbidden trajectory, timeout/downtrain, endpoint or sibling loss, new disqualifying error/reset or log gap, block further transitions and preserve the transaction. Do not fall back to Speed Change 12 or retry. Apply only the signed recovery and quarantine if required Gen3/full-width health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Source fields uniformly request Gen1-to-Gen3 500 times; missing capability and control values are project prerequisites rather than competing source claims.

blocked.reason: Review logic is complete; the execution state can become BLOCKED if the mapped path or proprietary artifact cannot support the required Gen3 target.
